method.timing: operation start until the end of the first frame whose visible rows, cells, selection, and row count match the reference, read just before the frame paints (ResizeObserver callback) and timed at a MessageChannel message posted then; raw times, including the check, whose cost is recorded as checkTime; frame rate limit disabled except for scroll traces, appends, and updates, which run with vsync
method.memory: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after forced GC: V8 heap + Blink heap + ArrayBuffer backing stores, one fresh page per sample; reserved = committed heap growth over a step without GC (not a peak)
method.processMemory: separate pages, as many as heap samples, from native input prepared to grid mounted, each reading after forced GC and a 500 ms pause: rendererBytes = the page's renderer process phys_footprint (macOS footprint); gpuBytes = GPU memory the renderer's memory-infra dump lists (webgl buffers and drawing buffers, canvas resources shared with the GPU process, cc tile memory); gpuProcessBytes = the GPU process's phys_footprint
